handoff: Approve: all three criteria are traced to tests that assert them (today's pins kept, the shared exit each flat edge left by, the shipped counting table). No blocking findings; 1 minor (a use route's max isn't observable until slice 02) and 1 nit (comments framed as history).

findings.title: The use route's max is reported but no test observes it yet
findings.detail:
AC2 asks for the use route's counter and max. exitOf (packages/store/src/shared-workflow.ts) copies `max`, but UseStep still refuses `max:` on a use route, so the test can only assert counter. The handoff records this; slice 02 adds max on a use route and should add the assertion.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: In slice 02, extend this test with a use route carrying `max:` and assert it in `exits`.

findings.title: Comments lean on history ('as it stood before counters could be derived')
findings.detail:
AGENTS.md: comments say why, never when or history. Lines 11-12 and the TABLE doc comment describe the files by a point in time; the why (an installed workflow must keep its pin; later edits must keep the counting) is present but framed as history.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Phrase as the invariant, e.g. 'frozen copies: an installed workflow keeps loading to its pin whatever the shipped files become'.
